text: Testing plays a vital role in software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly in isolation. Integration tests, on the other hand, verify that different parts of a system work together smoothly. A popular approach is test-driven development, where you write a failing test first, then write the minimum code to pass it, and finally improve the code. This method helps catch bugs early and makes the codebase easier to maintain. Most importantly, a good testing strategy gives developers confidence. When they change or add features, they can run the tests and know immediately if something has broken, which reduces fear and encourages steady progress.
